_comment: SELAE locality spellings that match no single INE municipality of their province, mapped to an INE municipality code. Add an entry only after checking in the INE Nomenclator (https://www.ine.es/nomen2/index.do) that the locality is a population entity of that municipality, and write where and when you checked it in 'source'. Read by scripts/gordo-snapshot.py. Shape: {"province": "35", "selae": "LAS PALMAS GC", "ine": "35016", "source": "INE Nomenclator, checked 2026-12-22"}
